verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm LM Studio serves an llms.txt at lmstudio.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured markdown summary). They also confirm markdown versions of doc pages, e.g. /docs/app.md, which an agent can ingest directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the agent-oriented docs, evidence of fuller coverage (e.g. llms-full.txt or comprehensive per-page .md across all docs), independent user corroboration of agents consuming them.
